study_identification_part.si_4_title: Revealing Individual Neuroanatomical Heterogeneity in Alzheimer Disease Using Neuroanatomical Normative Modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Reference dataset includes OASIS, ABCD, and UKB (n=33,072 from 60 sites). Clinical dataset is ADNI.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Participants were derived from 2 data sets: (1) a reference data set... including OASIS, Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study, and UKB... (2) a clinical target data set... obtained from the ADNI database

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Reference datasets (UKB, ABCD, OASIS) used for initial training. ADNI used for adaptation (70% controls) and testing (30% controls + patients).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: reference data set (training data)... estimates were conditioned to our specific context... using 70% of healthy controls per ADNI site... remaining 30% of healthy controls plus MCI and patients with AD were used to assess
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Verdi2023.pdf.md: Methods / Participants; Methods / Neuroanatomical Normative Modeling
